rulings.ruling: Ruling: genuine ambiguity (amb.2025.multiplication_subcent); project retained; model value dropped from the fixture. With a negative AGI, 7.5% of -$5,479.00 is -$410.925; the project's half-up rounding goes toward the larger value (-$410.92), the model's away from zero (-$410.93). The register entry governs the rounding of a product to the cent; the one-cent difference carries to lines 4 and 17.
